info.description:
Model for managing system-wide services and functions on network devices. Portions of this code were derived from IETF RFC 7317. Please reproduce this note if possible. **Module:** `openconfig-system`
**Root nodes:** system
**Paths:** 126 | **Operations:** 348

GET/PUT/PATCH/DELETE for config nodes, GET-only for state (config false) nodes.

**Includes augments from:** `cisco-xe-openconfig-system-ext`, `openconfig-openflow`, `openconfig-system-grpc`
